'''Kawata Shrine''' (かわたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} enshrined in {{ill|Konan, Shiga|ar|كونان (شيغا)|azb|کونان، شیقا|ce|Конан (Сига)|ceb|Konan-shi (distrito sa Hapon)|de|Konan|es|Konan (Shiga)|fa|کونان، شیگا|fi|Konan (Shiga)|fr|Konan (Shiga)|gl|Konan|hak|Konan-sṳ|hy|Կոնան (Սիգա)|id|Konan, Shiga|it|Konan (Giappone)|ja|湖南市|ko|고난시 (시가현)|mzn|کونان، شیگا|nl|Konan (Shiga)|pl|Konan|pt|Konan (Shiga)|ro|Konan, Shiga|ru|Конан (Сига)|sv|Konan, Shiga|tg|Конан, Шига|tl|Konan, Shiga|tr|Konan, Shiga|tt|Конан (Сига)|uk|Конан (Сіґа)|ur|کونان، شیگا|vi|Konan, Shiga|war|Konan, Shiga|zh|湖南市|zh_classical|湖南市|zh_min_nan|Konan-chhī|zh_yue|湖南市|qid=Q857194}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is a candidate shrine for a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and its former rank was {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
It enshrines {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|fr|Ama-no-Koyane-no-mikoto|it|Ame-no-Koyane|ja|天児屋命|mni|ꯑꯃꯦ-ꯅꯣ-ꯀꯣꯌꯅꯦ|pt|Ame-no-Koyane|ru|Амэ-но коянэ-но микото|simple|Ame-no-Koyane|zh|天兒屋命|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}.

=== History ===
The founding period is unknown. It is one of the candidate shrines for a {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}} listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}''. In October 1876 (Meiji 9), it was ranked as a village shrine.
